title: Portal to Cosmic Dreams
description: A surreal scene shows a woman in a white dress and metal mask reaching toward a small glowing alien in a crystal ball. Behind her, a dark doorway reveals a silhouetted figure with a backpack walking into a cosmic landscape filled with planets, stars, and screaming shadowy faces.
prompt: Surreal cosmic artwork of a woman wearing a white dress and intricate metal face mask, her hands reaching toward a glowing crystal ball containing a small purple alien with large eyes. Behind her is an open doorway showing a silhouetted hiker with a backpack walking into a starry space landscape with planets and swirling galaxies, while ghostly screaming faces emerge from the cracked wall in black and red tones with constellation patterns.
